- Faster native ANSI text wrapping on long lines with many words ([#16927](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16927) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Faster native memory reranking when selecting many results ([#16921](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16921) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Faster structural code summaries on large files ([#16993](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16993) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Faster native edit diff formatting and fuzzy line matching on large files ([#16926](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16926) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))
- Reduced native word-diff allocation overhead when joining tokens and deduplicating boundary whitespace ([#16922](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16922) by [@GTanger](https://github.com/GTanger))

### Fixed

- Fixed macOS `ax()` and `find()` leaving a text field with no label of its own, such as Reminders' Add Date and Add Location fields, unnamed; such a field is now named by its placeholder ([#16915](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16915) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed minimized `ruff check --output-format full` output counting code-frame lines with function calls, such as `14 | assert skill.read() == …`, as diagnostics and files, which inflated the `N diagnostics in M files` summary ([#16837](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16837))
- Fixed omp crashing with a stack overflow when an edit's path did not resolve to an existing file and the workspace search for it reached a deeply nested directory tree; directory walks no longer use a stack frame per nesting level ([#16857](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16857))
- Fixed the built-in `ps` crashing the shell on a non-ASCII character in an option cluster such as `ps -é`; it now reports `unsupported option '-é'` like any other unknown option ([#17019](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/17019) by [@sjawhar](https://github.com/sjawhar))
- Fixed computer use on macOS being unable to finish renaming a file in Finder: keys, `el.type` and `el.press` sent to the rename field were refused, and so were clicks in its window while Finder was your frontmost app ([#16910](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16910) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a UTF-8 char-boundary panic when parsing `stateDiagram-v2` lines where `>` follows a multibyte character ([#16749](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16749) by [@berney](https://github.com/berney))
- Fixed the bash tool's `rg` and `fd` on macOS and Linux finding nothing under a path that is a symlink to a directory, such as `/tmp` or `/etc` on macOS or a symlinked skill folder; like ripgrep and fd, they now search the folder the link points to ([#16598](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16598) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed minimized `git diff`, `git show` and `diff -u` output dropping a hunk's changes and listing a made-up file when a changed line starts with `-- ` or `++ ` (SQL comments, Markdown `---` rules) ([#16588](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16588) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the bash tool's minimizer summarizing word diffs (`git diff --word-diff`, `--color-words`, `--word-diff-regex`), which carry no per-line `+`/`-` markers; word-diff patches are now passed through unsummarized ([#16588](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16588) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed Mermaid flowcharts drawing two edges between the same pair of nodes as one line, with their labels written over each other; each edge now gets its own route, line style, arrowhead and label ([#16731](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16731))
- Fixed `renderMermaidAscii` starting an edge one cell away from its node's side when a labeled sibling edge leaves the same node from another side ([#16730](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16730))
- Fixed Mermaid flowchart parsing swallowing leading dashes of spaceless arrows (`A-->B`, `B-.->C`, `C:::cls-->D`) into the preceding node ID or class name ([#16750](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16750) by [@berney](https://github.com/berney))
- Fixed macOS `openApplication("Contacts")` and `openApplication("Messages")` failing as ambiguous because a helper of the app (an agent app or a running app extension) has the same name; a name shared only with such helpers now opens the app ([#16911](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16911) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a macOS background right or middle double click pressing again after you clicked or typed in its app between its presses; it now stops there with `UserIntervened`, as a left click does ([#16770](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16770) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed macOS background `axType`, `axKeyChord` and `axClick` sending input into an app you switched to while it was busy answering the element's window or bounds lookup; they now read your front app first and refuse with `UserIntervened`, as window input does. The refusal for an element that does not take focus now says no keys were sent, since the focus request reached the app ([#16769](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16769) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed the shell output minimizer cutting short `git diff`, `git show`, `diff`, `jq` and `ssh` output that fits in 16 KB: it now arrives whole, and the patch summary, the 40-line `jq` cap and the remote head/tail cut apply only to larger output ([#16589](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16589) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

## @oh-my-pi/pi-tui

### Breaking Changes

- `CoordinationOp` no longer includes `"jobs"`, which no tool has produced since `wait` and `proc://` replaced the `hub` tool ([#16763](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16763) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Fixed a table's last rows (such as its bottom border) going blank in scrollback when its SIXEL chart was drawn while the reply kept streaming, with the chart painted over them ([#16870](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16870))
- Fixed Tern MCP tool cards showing only a clipped one-line summary of the arguments; the call and result cards now include a folded `Args` section with the full arguments ([#16765](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16765))
- Fixed pasting an API key or redirect URL into the setup wizard's provider sign-in prompt silently doing nothing ([#16898](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16898) by [@camiloeferrera](https://github.com/camiloeferrera))
- Fixed the usage dashboard averaging distinct quota buckets that share a label and window (Google Antigravity's Gemini and Gemini 4 Argon weeklies) into one row, which masked a drained bucket as "50% left"; buckets now group by quota identity, and shared Claude/GPT copies still merge ([#16790](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16790))

### Added

- Added `modelEnds` to `GroupedFileSection`: per file, the model-line index just past its last line, so a caller cutting the output can tell which files it shows whole ([#16594](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16594) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))
- Added an optional `title` to `BtwHistoryRecord` and a `title` option to `BtwPanelComponent`: the `/btw` panel, history list and thread show it as the topic heading in place of the question, so a side command reads as `/sitrep` instead of its expanded template ([#16815](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16815) by [@wolfiesch](https://github.com/wolfiesch))
- Vim mode now supports `.` to repeat the last change, including the text typed in Insert or Replace mode, with Vim's count rules; `u` undoes a whole Insert session or `.` in one step ([#16872](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16872) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added the `app.local.open` keybinding (default `Alt+G`) and its keyboard shortcuts row ([#16873](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16873) by [@Shadorain](https://github.com/Shadorain))
- Added `errorKind` to `EditToolDetails`, set on a failed edit ([#16608](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16608) by [@will-bogusz](https://github.com/will-bogusz))

### Changed

- Command and eval output panes no longer re-style and re-join their whole output on every frame, so a long command's output stops costing frame time while it sits in the transcript ([#16779](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16779) by [@yuzu-octopus](https://github.com/yuzu-octopus))

### Fixed

- Fixed typo underlines changing when the cursor or selection splits a word ([#16821](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16821))
- Fixed completed `vibe_wait` and `vibe_list` worker cards repeatedly entering scrollback as elapsed time advanced after partial retirement; completed walls now retain a static snapshot while in-flight waits continue updating.
- Fixed resuming a session with a recorded tool-call path that cannot be turned into a link, which crashed the TUI while it rebuilt the context ([#16806](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16806) by [@laviRZ](https://github.com/laviRZ))
- Fixed the Agent Hub reordering its rows on every heartbeat while the session's saved subagents loaded, so no row could be selected until the load ended: a row's place is now fixed when the hub first shows it, an agent the load finds takes its place in the status/recency ranking, and every other new generation goes on top ([#10524](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/10524), [#16952](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16952) by [@lemonleks](https://github.com/lemonleks))
- Fixed the BTW history follow-up composer refusing pasted images; it now attaches them as `[Image #N]` markers and sends the ones whose marker stays in the draft ([#16805](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16805) by [@lemonleks](https://github.com/lemonleks))
- Fixed long URLs in fenced code blocks opening only their first visual line on ctrl/cmd-click; each wrapped fragment now carries the full OSC 8 hyperlink when the terminal supports it ([#16740](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16740) by [@OriginalByteMe](https://github.com/OriginalByteMe))
- Fixed the newest inline charts and images at the bottom of the screen showing as text placeholders while older ones stayed rendered once a session (or a resumed one) holds more than `tui.maxInlineImages` images ([#16660](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16660))
- Fixed Markdown tables in the terminal ignoring their column alignment, so right-aligned and centered columns rendered flush left ([#16658](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/pull/16658) by [@adi-IL](https://github.com/adi-IL))
- Grep, Glob, Find, and AST Grep result headers wrap a long pattern instead of cutting it off, so the match/file counts and `truncated` warning stay visible ([#16635](https://github.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/issues/16635))

name: v3.24.0 — Advisory checks of the panel's suggested references and findings, a one-process guard launcher, and integrity-rule repairs
body:
> **Two advisory reviewer checks and repairs; no new skill, and the checks' accuracy on real reviews is unmeasured:** v3.24.0 adds two attachments to the Editorial Decision Letter. The first looks up, live, each work that Reviewer 2 and Reviewer 3 recommend in the four indexes of the citation gate, and reports whether a record exists, not whether the work supports the recommendation (#1001). The second sends each weakness and each CRITICAL or MAJOR Devil's Advocate row, without its seat label, to a subagent of the session model, which says whether the manuscript contradicts it. A contradiction is listed only when the judge's quotation passes the script's check against the manuscript; other false verdicts are listed as not confirmed (#1002). It is on by default, and `ARS_PANEL_CLAIM_CHECK=0` turns it off. Neither attachment feeds the decision, the revision roadmap, or re-review criteria. Before the second check shipped, a preregistered held-out audit of 805 panel claims put the false-claim rate between 1.5% and 12.9%, and Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 passed its contrast gate as judges. The write-scope guard launcher starts one Python process per tool call instead of three, which should cut the Windows AppXSvc leak to about a third, although the Windows behaviour is untested here (#1015), and the guard's notes state which tool names it checks (#1022). Three integrity-check rules now agree on Stage 5 entry, report freshness, and Stage 4′ (#1011), and the startup notice appears only when an update is available (#1027). Outside users reported #1015, #1022, and #1027.

### Added

- **The Editorial Decision Letter carries a check of the references the panel suggests (#1001).** Reviewer 2 and Reviewer 3 now repeat each specific work they recommend in a `yaml suggested-references` block (title, and authors, year, DOI, or arXiv ID when they can attest them; `[]` when they name none). After the decision, the dispatching session runs `scripts/verify_panel_recommendations.py` on their saved reports and appends its table under `## Attachment: Suggested-Reference Check (advisory, #1001)`, before the acronym check, which stays the letter's last write. The script looks each work up through `verification_gate.verify_citation` with the four resolver clients of `verify_passport.py`, live and without the verification cache, and reports one of four results under the citation gate's C-V6(a) rule: found, DOI or arXiv ID not found, title not matched with no identifier to check, or not checked because an index that could settle it did not answer or the lookup failed. "Found" shows only that a record exists, not that the work supports the recommendation. Like the acronym check, the attachment is script output: the decision, the revision roadmap, and re-review criteria do not draw on it, and a suggestion it cannot find stays in the roadmap as the reviewer wrote it. `docs/DATA_FLOWS.md` names the new network use, and `shared/contracts/degradation_registry.json` adds its two degraded states. Tests use mocked resolver clients and synthetic reports; whether reviewers write the block, and how often their suggestions resolve, are unmeasured.

- **A preregistered held-out audit of the review panel's claims against the manuscript (#1002, part one).** `evals/heldout/panel_claim_factuality/` takes the 805 weaknesses and Devil's Advocate CRITICAL and MAJOR rows of the 17 score-eligible E4 panels, with the seat held back (`scripts/extract_panel_claims.py`), and `scripts/dispatch_panel_claim_audit.py` sends them to two judges, gpt-6-astra through codex and Gemini 4 Argon at medium thinking through the paid API under a spend cap, two replicates each. Both judges passed the contrast gate: each marked all 51 false contrast sentences false and none of the 51 accurate twins. The two judges agreed on 12 false claims, in 6 of the 17 panels, which meets the preregistered bar for planning part two; the other 92 claims (54 on which the judges diverged, 38 on which a judge's verdict was unresolved because its replicates differed or a false verdict failed the evidence check) were not adjudicated, so the false-claim rate is reported only as a range, 12/805 (1.5%) to 104/805 (12.9%), and no per-seat rate is computed. No person verified the 12 claims. The plan reached version 9 through recorded amendments; the scoring run is version 8 (Gemini outputs from that run, codex outputs from version 3, reused by prompt hash), and version 9 changes only the transports, under which those outputs score the same. The transports run on POSIX systems only (tested on macOS). No ARS skill, agent, or pipeline step changes.

- **Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 pass the #1002 contrast gate (#1002, plan version 10).** Part two of #1002 would use the session model as its judge only after that model passes the part-one contrast gate. `scripts/dispatch_panel_claim_audit.py` gains two contrast-only judges, `claude-opus-5-5` and `claude-fable-5-1`, each through `claude -p` at high effort with no tools and no MCP servers, an empty configuration directory, an allowlisted environment, and a temporary working folder that the script checks for project settings and git checkouts in it and every folder above it. The `--contrast-only` run sends only the 61 batches that hold a contrast sentence, and the `contrast-score` command applies the preregistered bars. Each model, in two replicates, marked all 51 false contrast sentences false and none of the 51 accurate twins. Claude Opus 5.5 wrote those sentences, so the test cannot separate judging skill from familiarity with them; gpt-6-astra passed the same sentences in part one. Their verdicts on reviewer claims are not scored, and no ARS skill, agent, or pipeline step changes.

- **The Editorial Decision Letter carries a check of the panel's findings against the manuscript (#1002, part two).** After the decision and the suggested-reference check, the dispatching session runs `scripts/audit_panel_claims.py prompt` on the manuscript and the five saved Phase 2 reports, sends the written prompt, unchanged, to one subagent of the session model with no tools, and runs `render` on the reply. The prompt is the part-one auditor prompt, with each Weakness and Devil's Advocate CRITICAL or MAJOR row under a neutral id in hash order and without its seat label; a finding's own words can still show its seat. The attachment, `## Attachment: Reviewer Claim Check (advisory, #1002)`, lists a finding the judge marked as contradicted only when the judge's quotation passes the script's check against the manuscript, and says that the check reads only the quotation's words, not its location or whether it contradicts the finding; other false verdicts are listed as not confirmed, and missing verdicts or a report that cannot be read make the coverage partial. Report and judge text goes into the letter as literal text. It is advisory: no call that writes the round's decision, roadmap, or letter sees it, later readers take no weakness, consensus item, revision, or roadmap entry from it, and the author decides what to do with each row. It is on by default; `ARS_PANEL_CLAIM_CHECK=0` turns it off. As the session-model judge, Claude Opus 5.5 and Claude Fable 5.1 passed the part-one contrast gate (plan version 10), as gpt-6-astra and Gemini 4 Argon did in part one through other transports; other models are untested, and the attachment says so. `shared/contracts/degradation_registry.json` adds its two degraded states. Tests use synthetic reports; whether sessions run the check, and how accurate its rows are on real reviews, are unmeasured.

### Changed

- **King & Worthington (2026) is the sixth human-in-the-loop anchor in the README (#1003; refs #1001, #1002).** *AI Article Reviews Dominate Human Peer Reviews at Their Best* compares Claude Opus 4.8 reviews, one per manuscript in each of two conditions, with paid expert reviews of the same 124 manuscripts. The new paragraph in the three READMEs that carry the section (en, zh-TW, es-ES) reports the head-to-head result, the two findings that bear on ARS's reviewer (additional sources without retrieval; AI claims contradicted by the manuscript), the paper's warning about revising for a published prompt, and its limits, including that its results "do not speak to" publication decisions. The two measurements it motivates are tracked as #1001 and #1002. No prompt, schema, lint, or runtime change.

- **The startup notice appears only when an update is available (#1027, #1028, reported by @kaneyxx).** Since v3.23.2 (#999), `scripts/announce-ars-loaded.sh` set `systemMessage` on every startup and clear, so a session with no update still opened with a line that asked the user for nothing. It now sets `systemMessage` only when the #544 update reminder is present, and the reminder keeps the loaded line after it. `additionalContext`, the routing core, the update checker, and the compact and resume short form are unchanged. To check that ARS is loaded, type `/ars-` for the command menu or open `/plugin`. A test pins that startup and clear set no `systemMessage` when no update is available.

- **The write-scope guard states which tool names it checks (#1022, reported by @alexxhchen-nu).** `scripts/ars_write_scope_guard.py` checks a call only when its tool name is exactly `Write`, `Edit`, `MultiEdit`, or `Bash`, the four names the `hooks/hooks.json` matcher sends it, and lets every other name through to the normal permission flow without checking it. Its module notes now say so, and say why other names are not matched case-insensitively or treated as aliases: a host tool under another name may send another payload shape, which the guard, once its manifest loads, would deny for every caller, the main session included, or check on only one of its files. New tests pin both sides, and pin the matcher and the guard's name set to each other. The guard's behaviour does not change.

### Fixed

- **The write-scope guard launcher starts one Python process per tool call, not three (#1015, reported by @Thenewmanator15).** On Windows with the Python Install Manager, `py` is an App Execution Alias, and each launch through it makes AppXSvc run an update check that leaks about 1.5 MB until the service stops (python/pymanager#396); on a busy machine this reached 42 GB. `hooks/run_guard.sh` probed the interpreter, ran the guard, and checked the guard's JSON with three launches of the first working candidate. It now runs one process per candidate: a short runner prints the marker, runs the guard in the same process with its output captured, and prints the guard's decision only when the guard exited 0 and printed a JSON object with `hookSpecificOutput`. A candidate that prints other text before the marker or after the decision is skipped, as before; a guard that fails after the marker still gives a pass-through. The runner uses `-I`, so `PYTHON*` variables, the user site, and modules in the working directory do not reach it; it reads the payload as UTF-8, flushes the guard's stderr advisories before it ends, and forwards the decision as ASCII JSON on one line followed by an end line. The `timeout` call now passes `-k 1s`, so a guard that ignores SIGTERM is killed one second after the bound, and the separate JSON check, which had no time bound, is gone. Each call still launches through the alias once, so the leak is about a third of the earlier rate, not zero. Tests simulate the interpreters on a POSIX host; the Windows behaviour is untested here.

- **The integrity-check rules agree on three points (#1011).** Entering at Stage 5 with a revised paper now runs Stage 4.5 first, which rule 12 of `shared/handoff_schemas.md` requires, and a prior integrity report is context for it, as the orchestrator's decision tree already said; the mode advisor had said the user could skip Stages 1-4.5 by showing a pass report. A prior report counts as fresh only when it is less than 24 hours old, within one session too; rule 11 and the orchestrator's decision tree had also accepted any report from the current session, and rule 10 now calls a report stale at 24 hours, the same boundary as the decision tree. The Stage 4 entry row no longer lists Stage 4′ as always run: after Stage 3′, only a Major decision leads to Stage 4′. The changes are prompt-level wording and unmeasured.

name: Reasonix Studio v2.53.1
body:
本版修复 2.53.0 里放大后的设置窗口头部按钮点不动的问题，并让语义路由用量计入共享预算。

## 修复

- 2.53.0 里放大后的设置窗口，头部的收起、关闭、最小化、最大化按钮和搜索框点不动；现在都可以点击。修复 #14596 fixed in #14597。
- 语义路由用量在路由前就绑定根预算，计入规划与执行共享的软额度，保留缓存决定和任务边界。关联 #14595 by @SivanCola。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@SivanCola

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## Fixed

- In 2.53.0 the enlarged settings window's header buttons (collapse, close, minimise, maximise) and search field did not respond; they do now. Fixes #14596 fixed in #14597.
- Semantic routing usage is bound to the root budget before routing, counting in the soft limit shared by planning and execution, with cached decisions and task boundaries kept. Refs #14595 by @SivanCola.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @SivanCola

## What's Changed
* fix(control): include semantic routing in root budgets / 语义路由计入根预算 by @SivanCola in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14595
* fix(studio): the full-window settings header's buttons respond to clicks by @esengine in https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/14597


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/compare/studio-v2.53.0...studio-v2.53.1


---

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

name: Reasonix Studio v2.53.0
body:
本版新增跨项目派发、厂商图标、壁纸场景图层和个人预设默认，加固配对设备、git 读命令和项目配置的信任边界，并修复多处预算与界面问题。

## 新增

- （随派发开关，默认关闭）被派发出去的会话做完任务后，会自己把最终答复送回派发它的会话，不用你再来回转述；回信不会再触发回信。关联 #13341。
- （默认关闭）打开派发开关后，模型可请你把一批文件夹开成项目；一张卡逐条列出路径，你批准后才加入并标记为可信，之后才能向它们派发任务。关联 #13341。
- （随派发开关，默认关闭）别的会话发来消息时，接收的会话在列表里标为未读，你看到它之后才消失；不再要你自己发现。关联 #13341。
- 常用服务列表按厂商筛选并显示厂商图标，模型菜单里预设来源的模型也带上对应厂商图标。关联 #14538。
- Wallpaper Engine 场景支持多图层合成与逐音轨音量/循环，并保留 effects 元数据供后续 shader 接入。Refs #14561 by @EMEEEEMMMM。
- 设置「人设」里你自己的预设现在也能点「设为默认」作为新任务默认；该预设被删除后，新任务会改用内置的并忘掉这个默认。关联 #14572 fixed in #14575。

## 变更

- 项目 `reasonix.toml` 里的 `agent.system_prompt_file` 只有在你信任该文件夹后才会读取；未信任时忽略并在启动提示里说明，信任后恢复。关联 #13061。
- 配对的手机不能再安装或启用插件、MCP 和钩子，也不能自己指定要打开的文件夹，只能用窗口已列出的文件夹。关联 495a23478、b8b7ac87f。
- 未信任的项目文件夹里的 AGENTS.md 等常驻指令会标明“未验证”，模型只当作项目信息；项目自己声明的 MCP 常驻加载不再生效。关联 4ca33493a、e8c22e7ce。
- 放大设置窗口后铺满整个窗口，含顶部和底部，Windows 的窗口按钮在设置头部里；放大按钮的箭头随状态向外或向内。关联 #14418 fixed in #14420。
- 极长会话里，右侧历史轨道上表示多条的合并条现在鼠标移上去就展开可选的条目，移开自动收起。关联 #14525 by @imcreazy。
- 计划栏现在是输入框上方独立的卡片，展开的列表有明确的收起按钮，按 Esc 或点到外面也会收起，并写出条数。关联 #14530。


## 修复

- Anthropic 流中断时保留已知用量，并标记记账不完整；重试分类、请求计数和取消边界保持不变。关联 #14025。
- 活跃 Agent 根 context 内的有界 reviewer/advisor 用量现在计入既有 token 软预算，保留缺失用量、零阈值、局部遥测和独立请求边界。关联 #14025。
- 缺失或估算的供应商用量不再把 Agent 成本标成完整；保留准确请求次数与已知金额，已知费用达到显式预算仍软收尾。关联 #14025。
- 规划与执行共用显式配置的根 token 和时间软预算；保留仅规划、审批、继续、换任务及后台作业边界。关联 #14025。
- 子任务 provider 回调 panic 后，前台图和 transcript 会一致记录失败；旧式 nil panic 不再让后台子任务误报成功。关联 #14025。
- 中断流重建的用量不再被报价层标成完整成本；保留估算金额和既有币种账本，后续准确调用不抹掉不确定性。关联 #14025。
- 宿主 Git 的 worktree 准备不再继承外部索引或对象存储变量，保留显式私有索引和仓库备用对象库。关联 #14025。
- 隔离任务被拒绝时（结果不存在、未启用隔离、不是 Git 工作区、整合冲突、参数不支持），工具卡片会说明原因，不再空白。关联 #14025。
- 活跃 Agent 根任务中的摘要与失败诊断用量现在计入既有 token 软预算，保留缺失用量、零阈值、局部遥测和无根 context 手动维护的行为。关联 #14025。
- 显式 `task_token_budget` 共享累计 Agent task/fleet 子树已报告的 token，包括后台 job 和缓存输入。默认不限，保留软收尾；不是硬预留或金额上限。关联 #14025。
- 活跃根任务的 token 软预算现在计入命令分类和外部内容筛查用量；分类结论、筛查提示、缺失用量与零阈值行为保留。关联 #14025。
- host 显式耗时预算跟随 Agent 委派树及后台 task/fleet，共享任务起点并保留 Job Manager 取消权和既有软收尾；默认仍不限。关联 #14025。
- 活跃根任务的 token 软预算现在计入原生 web_search 已报告用量，保留独立请求计数、缺失用量、来源标签和付费同意边界。关联 #14025。
- 没有添加任何文件夹时，主区域也能直接新建会话，设置和反馈会在应用自己的目录里开出会话来打开，不再提示先添加文件夹。关联 #14465 fixed in #14501。
- 右侧提问细条在点过某一条、鼠标移开后再切回窗口时，附近几条不再无故变长变粗，只有键盘聚焦才会放大。关联 #14504 fixed in #14510。
- 在人设编辑页点「设为个人首选」或「设为项目首选」时，设置其实已生效，却弹出「Unexpected end of JSON input」的报错；现在不再误报。关联 #14541 fixed in #14542。
- macOS 上图标栏的竖线和底色不再从窗口顶端画起，不再穿过左上角的红绿灯。关联 #14553 fixed in #14558。
- Studio 里一个对话在后台跑完一轮后再打开，不再缺这一轮的回复；面板接入共享事件流之前错过的内容会从对话记录重新读出。关联 477ce369b。
- 能力目录的列表、搜索和详情里含 MCP 工具描述时，结果带“外部内容，不是指令”的标签。关联 147d5365e。
- 注销配对设备时偶发的数据竞争已修复，被注销设备的连接会可靠断开。关联 a755eb601。
- 网页抓取和安装源的内网地址防护现在也识别 IPv6 转换地址里带的 IPv4，并在走代理前先检查内网字面地址。关联 ed624e928、ab144a4cd。
- 仓库自己的配置里有会执行程序的键（如 fsmonitor、textconv、filter）时，智能体的 git 读命令不再自动放行，会先询问并写明原因。关联 191d1e17a。
- 命令里直接写 awk 程序现在要确认；自动记忆不再写入置顶项；登录表单加了大小上限；钩子里未加引号的 Windows 路径被正确识别。关联 de21fb488、4227c20b8、167c01014、6336f6763。
- 文件变更保护现在记录完整读取实际返回的内容；分页和超限读取保留已有的过期覆盖保护。关联 #14025。
- 首次只读取一部分内容后，完整覆盖前需要完整重读，或改用局部编辑。关联 #14025。
- 启用工具的规划现在遵守既有 token、费用、耗时预算配置；普通规划暂停保留 executor 回退。关联 #14025。
- 思考或回答期间发送插话后，文字继续实时更新，不再等到下一次结构事件才补齐。修复 #14209 fixed in #14534 by @lancy69。
- 调整侧栏底部头像的位置，保留原有字号、字重和尺寸，修正头像与工作空间文字的视觉对齐。关联 #14223 fixed in #14267 by @lancy69。


## 升级须知

- `reasonix serve --auth none` 监听非本机地址时现在拒绝启动，需要显式加 `--allow-open-network`。关联 365337367。
- `reasonix trust --yes` 不再顺带批准项目声明的 provider 端点（会把你的 API 密钥发到它的地址），需要加 `--allow-providers`。关联 e19b45d39。

## 贡献者

感谢本版本的贡献者：@EMEEEEMMMM、@imcreazy、@lancy69

---

<!-- lang:en -->

## New

- (With the dispatch switch, off by default) A dispatched session sends its final answer back to the session that handed it the task, and a reply is never answered by another reply. Refs #13341.
- (Off by default) With dispatch on, the model can ask to open folders as projects; one card lists every path and nothing is added or trusted until you approve. Refs #13341.
- (With the dispatch switch, off by default) A session that receives a message from another session is marked unread in the list until you look at it, instead of you having to notice. Refs #13341.
- The preset list filters by vendor and shows vendor marks, and models from a preset source carry the vendor mark in the model menu. Refs #14538.
- Scene wallpapers composite their image layers, honor per-track volume and loop mode, and keep effect metadata for a future shader pass. Refs #14561 by @EMEEEEMMMM.
- In Settings, your own agent presets can now be made the new task default; if one is deleted, new tasks fall back to the built-in one and forget it. Refs #14572 fixed in #14575.

## Changed

- A project's `agent.system_prompt_file` is read only once you trust the folder; until then it is ignored with a startup notice. Refs #13061.
- A paired phone can no longer install or enable plugins, MCP servers or hooks, or name a folder to open; it uses folders the window already lists. Refs 495a23478, b8b7ac87f.
- Standing instructions from an untrusted folder are labelled unverified, and a project's own MCP always-load no longer applies. Refs 4ca33493a, e8c22e7ce.
- An enlarged settings window fills the whole window, with the Windows buttons in its header; the enlarge button's arrows turn inward. Refs #14418 fixed in #14420.
- In very long conversations a folded line on the history rail opens its questions on hover and closes when the pointer leaves. Refs #14525 by @imcreazy.
- The plan bar is its own card above the composer, with a collapse button (Esc or a press outside also closes it) and a step count. Refs #14530.


## Fixed

- Anthropic interruptions retain known usage as incomplete accounting, preserving retry classification, request counts and cancellation boundaries. Refs #14025.
- Bounded reviewer/advisor usage in an active Agent root now counts toward its token soft budget. Missing usage, zero limits and isolated requests retain their behavior. Refs #14025.
- Missing or estimated provider usage no longer certifies complete Agent costs. Exact request counts and known-cost soft landing remain. Refs #14025.
- Planning and execution share configured root token/wall soft budgets, preserving plan-only, approval, continuation, task replacement and background-job boundaries. Refs #14025.
- Delegated provider panics now settle foreground graph and transcript as failed, and legacy nil panics cannot publish successful background work. Refs #14025.
- Reconstructed stream usage no longer certifies a complete cost quote. Estimated amounts and currency ledgers remain; later reported calls preserve uncertainty. Refs #14025.
- Host Git worktree preparation drops ambient index and object storage overrides, preserving explicit private indexes and repository alternates. Refs #14025.
- Tool cards now say why an isolated task was refused (unknown result, isolation off, no Git workspace, apply conflict, unsupported arguments). Refs #14025.
- Active-root summary and failure-diagnosis usage now counts toward its token soft budget. Missing usage, zero limits and local telemetry retain their behavior. Refs #14025.
- Explicit `task_token_budget` shares reported tokens across Agent task/fleet descendants. Defaults stay unlimited; existing soft landing remains. Refs #14025.
- Active root token soft budgets now include command-classification and external-screening usage, preserving verdicts, advisory notices, missing usage and zero limits. Refs #14025.
- Explicit host wall budgets follow Agent delegation and background jobs, retaining Manager cancellation and soft landing. Defaults stay unlimited. Refs #14025.
- Active root token soft budgets now include native web_search usage, preserving independent request counts, missing usage, provenance and paid-search consent. Refs #14025.
- With no folder added, the main area offers a new session, and settings and feedback open one in the app's own workspace instead of asking for a folder first. Refs #14465 fixed in #14501.
- The right-hand question rail no longer magnifies marks near one you pressed when the window regains focus with the mouse elsewhere; only keyboard focus does. Refs #14504 fixed in #14510.
- "Set as personal default" and "Set as project default" on a persona applied but showed "Unexpected end of JSON input"; an empty success answer is no longer read as JSON. Refs #14541 fixed in #14542.
- On macOS the icon rail's edge and background no longer start at the top of the window, so they no longer cut through the window controls. Fixes #14553 fixed in #14558.
- A conversation that ran a turn in the background no longer opens without that turn's reply; what its pane missed before the shared stream attached it is read back. Refs 477ce369b.
- Capability catalog answers that quote MCP-written tool descriptions carry the external-content label. Refs 147d5365e.
- A data race when a paired device is revoked; its open streams are now cut reliably. Refs a755eb601.
- The web fetch and install-source guards now judge the IPv4 an IPv6 transition address carries, and refuse an internal literal before a proxy is used. Refs ed624e928, ab144a4cd.
- Agent git reads (diff, log, show, blame, status) are no longer auto-approved in a repository whose own config runs programs; they ask first and name the key. Refs 191d1e17a.
- An inline awk program needs approval, auto memory never pins, the login form is size-capped, and an unquoted Windows hook path is read as written. Refs de21fb488, 4227c20b8, 167c01014.
- File change protection records the complete returned read; pages and oversized reads preserve the earlier guard. Refs #14025.
- After a partial read, read the file in full before a whole-file overwrite, or use a targeted edit. Refs #14025.
- Tool-enabled planning honours the configured token, cost and time budgets; normal planner pauses keep the executor fallback. Refs #14025.
- Reasoning and answers keep streaming while guidance waits in the queue, instead of freezing until the next structural event. Fixes #14209 fixed in #14534 by @lancy69.
- Adjusted the sidebar footer avatar placement, keeping its font size, weight and dimensions. Refs #14223 fixed in #14267 by @lancy69.


## Upgrade notes

- `reasonix serve --auth none` now refuses to start on an address other machines can reach unless you pass `--allow-open-network`. Refs 365337367.
- `reasonix trust --yes` no longer approves a provider endpoint the folder declares, which would receive your API key; add `--allow-providers`. Refs e19b45d39.

## Contributors

Thanks to this release's contributors: @EMEEEEMMMM, @imcreazy, @lancy69

**macOS** 已用 Developer ID 签名并公证，打开时不需要清除隔离属性。**Windows** 的窗口、内核与安装器都经 Certum 代码签名证书做了 Authenticode 签名。**Linux** Debian 系从 `.deb` 安装，Fedora、RHEL、openSUSE 等从 `.rpm` 安装（`sudo dnf install ./ReasonixStudio-linux-amd64.rpm`）。x86_64 用文件名带 amd64 的包，aarch64（统信 UOS、麒麟等）用带 arm64 的包。也提供 `.AppImage`（只提供下载，不会自更新；需要 FUSE 2，或用 `--appimage-extract-and-run` 启动）。

三个平台都能自更新：Linux 的 `.deb` 走自己的包（`.rpm` 的自更新尚未提供，请手动下载新包），Windows 运行下一个安装器，macOS 替换自身 bundle。

## 2026.10.10-beta.4

### Highlights

### Changes

### Fixes

- Automations: preserve authenticated operator authority for explicit same-conversation scheduled follow-ups, including one-shot `next_check` rearming, while retaining role, session, cancellation, target, and tool-policy revocation boundaries. (#176422) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Gateway security: keep an environment-referenced `hooks.token` out of agent host-exec and CLI child environments at startup and across config reloads, while preserving explicit per-command overrides. (#179199) Thanks @VACInc and @RomneyDa.
- Memory Wiki: preserve human-authored Notes when OKF concept pages are re-imported or removed from the producer bundle, including changed producer content and legacy pages without a marked Notes slot. (#175707, #179657; related #175700) Thanks @YangManBOBO and @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI: keep the native Claude session and its context when subagent completions or channel turns run in a Control UI-started session, instead of reseeding from saved history each time. (#178955; fixes #178953) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @RomneyDa.
- Model catalogs: honor a configured primary account pin when deciding model readiness, so native Claude CLI models no longer appear as missing auth when the selected token profile is ready. (#178522; related #178502) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @RomneyDa, and @eduardonunesfreire-rgb.
- Backup and restore: preserve supported legacy exec-approval allowlists when sanitizing snapshots instead of replacing them with deny-all; malformed policies remain fail-closed. (#164297) Thanks @wangmiao0668000666, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @cristianoc, and @brucemccurdy.
- Linux companion: persist each saved Gateway dashboard's private browser identity across restarts, while removing storage for deleted Gateways so re-added endpoints pair as fresh devices. (#158908) Thanks @dor-sr, @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- Agent database lifecycle: keep peer readers and borrowers alive when maintenance or PostgreSQL opening is refused, preserve the original refusal and clean-restart seal, and retain pre-dispatch recovery behavior when a worker generation disappears. (#175987, #163258, #179320) Thanks @RomneyDa, @shanselman, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, @brucemccurdy, @goutamadwant, and @hawkit.
- macOS bundled Gateway: show the actual installed Gateway version, keep failed or incomplete recovery actionable, and prevent stale or pending update receipts from blocking a valid repair. (#181389) Thanks @shanselman, @RomneyDa, @dor-sr, @wangmiao0668000666, and @brucemccurdy.
- Model refresh: let explicit catalog refreshes use their existing extended discovery budget through HTTP acquisition while ordinary preparation remains bounded. (#177313) Thanks @jlapenna and @RomneyDa.
- Webhooks and scheduled scripts: classify trusted immediate producers as events, retain each webhook's own automation scope, and refresh disposed script hooks before execution without replaying completed effects. (#172775, #177825, #178904) Thanks @RomneyDa, @jlapenna, and @jalehman.
- Runtime security: backport patched embedded runtimes to the 2026.10.10 line. (#181074) Thanks @RomneyDa and @joshavant.
- Update finalization: keep a verified healthy target successful when a recognized late restart-health or legacy-wrapper maintenance step fails, while authority, data-at-risk, deferred-admission, and unknown failures remain fatal. (#181166; fixes #181020) Thanks @najef1979-code.
- Package update recovery: automatically settle verified interrupted publications or retire untouched preparations, preserve the installed candidate and original Gateway recovery evidence, and keep live update ownership and restart authority fenced. (#181307; fixes #181235) Thanks @agroman1993.
- CLI config writes and setup with a running Gateway: `openclaw config set`, `config unset`, and `openclaw setup` now send their change through the running Gateway as one `config.patch` instead of refusing, with the same result as an offline write, no restart while reload is off, and a success acknowledgement when the Gateway accepts a restart, so Windows companion setup completes again. (#182951, #184194, #184392, #184532, #185109) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- Codex native subagents: unblock parent replies after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups; stop resurrecting undeliverable child completions; replay completed grandchildren correctly after Gateway restarts; keep native tool declarations across completion turns; and let Stop succeed after parent thread reuse. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179050, #179099, #183286, #181475; fixes #178395) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @mmartoccia, @wtfichigo, @Marvinthebored, and @RomneyDa.
- Claude CLI: stop prompt-cache prefix churn after a child completion. (#172026) Thanks @Marvinthebored and @VACInc.
- Scheduled runs: wait for tool results before answering, so cron run summaries report the real result instead of a premature "no results" reply. (#179690) Thanks @obviyus.
- Agent restart recovery: release restart-recovery fences for killed runs so their conversations no longer stay blocked. (#181992; fixes #181952) Thanks @najef1979-code.
- Windows exec: restore command execution for Gateways running as an S4U scheduled task when Store PowerShell is installed. (#182898; fixes #182652) Thanks @RomneyDa and @tre1d.
- Kimi: give Kimi K3.1 Pro the K3 thinking and video controls. (#181923) Thanks @obviyus.

### Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.10.10-beta.3..ed2b311521579d51523c9e31f1c326310e2c2922 history: 60 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 60 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

name: openclaw 2026.10.8
body:
## 2026.10.8

### Highlights

- **Updates that finish and recover:** an ordinary post-update Doctor failure restarts the Gateway instead of leaving it stopped, an orphaned maintenance worker no longer blocks every CLI command and Gateway start, and updates no longer abort on ACL filesystems, Windows pnpm optional-dependency links, pnpm 10 global installs, debug console logging, or a missing legacy OAuth directory. (#180668, #181695, #181141, #181596, #181456, #182850, #180174) Thanks @hannesrudolph, @SMF12138, @rayluo88, @PonySlayer28, and @VN77-77VN.
- **Gateway service installs on every desktop:** macOS recovers a loaded launchd registration whose plist was deleted, Linux installs under the Ubuntu default umask create a private state directory instead of being refused, and the macOS updater waits for the serving Gateway to release its databases before Doctor runs. (#180390, #179538, #182055) Thanks @avnishkirnalli and @XiaoPengYouCode.
- **Conversations keep accepting messages:** killed runs release their restart-recovery fence, interrupted and just-accepted child sessions recover after a Gateway restart, inbound messages stop retrying forever when the reply runtime cannot publish, and the Control UI forgotten-send retry delivers the reply instead of an authoring error. (#181992, #178888, #181871, #181300, #182219) Thanks @najef1979-code, @handcraftrc-pixel, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
- **Startup and database resilience:** startup work no longer inherits a closed SQLite reader scope, so models, chat metadata and channel replies stay available; transient lock contention during agent database startup is retried; and model catalogs stay available during skill runs. (#182615, #182446, #182385)
- **Security hardening:** exec allowlist mode requires approval for `test -v` operand expansion, generic node invoke refuses browser proxy commands, sandboxed spawned children cannot run host CLI backends, the secret egress proxy rejects distrusted eMudhra chains, Fish Audio and Gradium errors no longer expose API keys, and deeply nested Tlon content can no longer stall the channel. (#180880, #179880, #178742, #179249, #178877, #177536) Thanks @eleqtrizit and @joshavant.
- **Windows exec and plugins:** agent exec works under S4U scheduled tasks while Store PowerShell is installed, native plugins load on machines with Endpoint DLP, and Doctor recovers dangling dependency junctions and plugins on another filesystem. (#182898, #179949, #179549, #179445) Fixes #182652 Thanks @RomneyDa, @tre1d, @coaiMax, @paulcam206, @JIRBOY, and @ceckert.
- **Provider and model continuity:** Codex turns keep their budget with older runtime plugins instead of silently falling back, Codex native child inference works after startup, OpenAI OAuth works with stale catalogs, Anthropic PDF analysis works with setup-token OAuth, a timed-out MCP session close no longer fails the next turn, and CLI history owner changes stop instead of silently replaying on another provider. (#182995, #176311, #181356, #178420, #182189, #180075) Fixes #181619 Thanks @RomneyDa, @kip-claw, @enki, @sasan1200, @sunlit-deng, @khensthoth, @aniketkrs, @goslingmanagment, @wr-web, and @teddashh.

### Changes

- **Fresh OpenAI setup:** first-run model metadata no longer restricts the model picker to one model. (#175945) Thanks @matthematics1137 and @jb-dev1.

### Fixes

- **Channel accounts:** default Slack, Google Chat, X, Nextcloud Talk and Zalo accounts keep starting and keep their secrets after a named account is added. (#176267, #180450, #182608) Thanks @555aaditya, @progerjkd, and @masatohoshino.
- **Slack:** an isolated `invalid_auth` is retried before a socket-mode channel is disabled, and silent relay network drops reconnect. (#181056, #182368) Thanks @mushuiyu886 and @marns.
- **Matrix, Twitch, Zalo, iMessage and Feishu delivery:** ordinary Matrix messages are no longer treated as text commands, Twitch sends normalize channel targets, Zalo DMs with URLs are handled, iMessage recovers after the Messages bridge dies, and Feishu quick-action cards send again. (#179506, #178480, #178938, #180900, #79832) Thanks @xiaopan-xydt, @doomy, @HeZ2z, @Takhoffman, @zzrs-xxxr, @namchamvinhcuu, and @xiabee.
- **Agent runs and providers:** heartbeat loops stop when background commands finish, temporary Codex probe workers no longer accumulate, Codex native turns stay alive during host work, Claude CLI turns no longer stall 15 minutes when stream output hits its limit, provider stream errors surface immediately, and session admission races no longer trigger model fallback. (#179060, #167390, #181839, #159931, #117397, #179347) Fixes #178937, #181805, and #178000 Thanks @maxdjohnson, @sunlit-deng, @Terwox, @AINCHORS, @robertmsale, and @davidcittadini.
- **Voice and meetings:** Discord realtime voice consults initialize their runtime, voice calls use the configured agent model, and long meeting talk-back replies keep their audio. (#179462, #181451, #178254) Thanks @shoaibulhaque, @yagizkus, @potoior, @BeyonceBot, and @sukhdeepjohar.
- **Remote access and history:** Tailscale Serve and Funnel recover after tailscaled restarts, and cron history stays readable after provider changes. (#180081, #181311) Thanks @enki, @saariuslystoned, and @xtimor.
- **Doctor repairs:** retained transcripts verify after heading repairs, and repair keeps the Codex host compaction model. (#179089, #179914) Thanks @mrsavingsblogspot-rgb and @LiuwqGit.
- **Plugins and nodes:** older plugin debounce callbacks keep working, computer use accepts input results from older Mac nodes, and Memory Wiki keeps user Notes when OKF concepts disappear. (#118011, #137755, #179657)
- **Secrets and hooks:** the 1Password secret provider accepts group-writable OpenClaw files, and concurrent session-memory captures no longer overwrite each other. (#181127, #181081) Thanks @jalehman, @jason-allen-oneal, and @yetval.
- **Doctor recovery messages:** when Doctor cannot restore a Gateway it stopped, it prints the failure and how to start the Gateway. (#181941)
- **Codex native children and replies:** completed or undeliverable child completions no longer replay or wedge parents, replies unblock after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete follow-ups, final answers survive transient retries, settled turns without a mirrored prompt finalize, native tool declarations stay stable, queued chats recover after plugin reloads, submitted steering commits before terminal release, and Codex accepts managed loopback proxy defaults. (#173018, #175246, #177577, #179099, #179050, #183286, #181779, #183077, #182104, #184062, #183232) Thanks @quqi1599, @Stronggenetics, @linancn, @wtfichigo, @mmartoccia, @Marvinthebored, @sukhdeepjohar, @jjjhenriksen, @aatreya, @ermaxinc, and @RomneyDa.
- **Claude CLI sessions:** unrelated native tasks no longer hold the final answer, parent replies finish after nested background agents, a stopped first turn keeps its conversation, room events no longer reset sessions, operators can keep native Agent and Workflow tools, resumed sessions see conversation updates, and Claude CLI models stay available with saved subscriptions. (#170322, #182267, #181966, #182273, #183765, #183059, #179203) Thanks @cassthebandit, @VACInc, @goslingmanagment, @holgergruenhagen, @xiaopan-xydt, @Marvinthebored, @scarabone, @atomsmasher81, @josh-cornelius, and @teddashh.
- **Subagents and agent turns:** model fallback stops after local runtime faults, recovered child results deliver after session reuse, private completion receipts reconcile after a restart, parents keep waiting for active collectors, batched tool calls settle before `sessions_yield`, delayed `sessions_send` replies are no longer cut at 4,096 characters, turns finish after tool-result recovery, messages sent during transcript rebuilds are recovered, and completed attempt callbacks are released. (#180042, #184069, #184041, #172959, #184021, #178271, #175685, #182666, #164843, #183884) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @danielsiemers, @johan-eilertsen, @jailbirt, @rjdotdev, @wr-web, @seriouslysean, @MSNexploder, and @PollyBot13.
- **Gateway stability and streaming:** long HTML and JSX answers, crafted Teams HTML, and replies that look like tool calls no longer stall the Gateway; reasoning tags are withheld before streaming; silent turns no longer send rich payloads; channel restarts survive exited-run cancellation; the Gateway closes after forced plugin retirement; plugin service schedules outlive the scope that created them; and cold tool inventories no longer grow memory. (#175472, #183438, #183252, #182454, #129244, #182433, #181270, #182207, #178596) Thanks @JasonBuildAI, @LeizhenZhang, @zax0rz, @JOY, @0xtc23, @bguliano, @obviyus, and @wuqxuan.
- **Updates, installs and Doctor:** Windows managed updates no longer lock themselves on TEMP aliases, the Windows installer runs through `iex`, updates complete during channel outages and keep accepted policy pins, stopped database backups allow readers, Doctor restores the Gateway after SIGHUP, keeps valid reseeded configs and inherited logins, repairs unsupported Node runtimes, recovers agents after deletion journal loss, restores plugin host links, handles very large retained histories, and uses less memory on large fleets. (#183622, #183145, #179471, #180505, #180827, #182901, #183703, #179726, #181618, #181804, #181140, #180414, #180792, #181465) Thanks @ryandle, @duyufansh2008, @waynegault, @csabatatrai, @samueltardieu, @4140leal-cw, @rybing7, @RomneyDa, @LiuwqGit, @sukhdeepjohar, and @teddashh.
- **Sessions and storage:** relative session stores resolve against the state directory, sessions archive through symlinked state paths, stale restart-recovery sources no longer wedge sessions, cron cleanup keeps live child sessions, archived Discord slash-command sessions restore in place, background plugin work keeps its SQLite reader, and session deletes reuse warm archive workers. (#182444, #181554, #180853, #179057, #168596, #179031, #171156, #175091, #183410) Thanks @erickj92, @Cloud-Ocean, @Oldrich333, and @PollyBot13.
- **Auth and providers:** rate-limited profiles cool down only as long as the provider asks, shared OAuth refreshes past deleted peers, concurrent agents keep MCP tool access while an OAuth credential is leased, utility models no longer return thinking-only replies, custom GLM providers generate session titles, Kimi K3.1 Pro gets the K3 thinking and video controls, Bedrock Mantle GPT models route through Responses, Google streams recover, and native conversations survive a compaction fallback model. (#180280, #179205, #179997, #169920, #172580, #181923, #182437, #117194, #183282) Thanks @fuller-stack-dev, @WG-Mojo, @maliv2, @danielsiemers, @jacobtomlinson, @TommyLei666, @obviyus, @rayvader, and @pstarkgit.
- **Channels:** Telegram and Mattermost default accounts keep their tokens after a named account is added, X accounts with capitalized keys can be managed and synced, iMessage stops answering its own self-chat replies, Feishu keeps streamed text across tool calls, Google Chat delivers remote attachments as links, Synology Chat stops reporting false delivery failures, Tlon recovers after network drops, and channel images a turn could not read are retried. (#183618, #182706, #183263, #183461, #183383, #182438, #182416, #177654, #178358, #183390) Thanks @555aaditya, @rodricksz4h5, @wangmiao0668000666, @nxmxbbd, @sukhdeepjohar, @felirami, @kentuscn, @jailbirt, @HootRock, @masatohoshino, @yetval, and @teddashh.
- **Voice, apps and browser:** realtime Talk survives early output and brief Gateway stalls, GPT-Live Talk and Bun realtime voice use the managed proxy, oversized macOS recordings error instead of disconnecting the node, Android chat binds to an allowed agent, the Tauri app no longer crashes before the dashboard is ready, FaceTime accepts new calls after a disconnect, the Control UI detects dead Gateway links, and browser control no longer rewrites trusted-proxy Gateway auth or holds profile leases after timeouts. (#182919, #180572, #175886, #176567, #182593, #182767, #183841, #154230, #179101, #181620, #154246) Thanks @anmol0b, @StatsR4Losers, @kybrcore, @MertBasar0, @jalehman, @CheatosBu, @xiaopan-xydt, @dawidkulpa, @Solvely-Colin, @fuller-stack-dev, and @LLagoon3.
- **Config, cron and workspaces:** Control UI saves accept fully masked SecretRefs, short session URLs with navigation hints load, cron jobs keep running after sending to their own target and after a hook plugin is replaced, provisioned workspaces work without templates, Windows workspace sync no longer fails before lease acquisition, trusted-proxy readiness probes succeed without forwarded headers, and restart-recovery notices no longer claim a Gateway restart. (#183571, #183148, #177518, #177825, #120943, #183064, #182823, #172843) Thanks @lonexreb, @Valkster70, @xiaopan-xydt, @2991495215, @masatohoshino, @jlapenna, @shakkernerd, @ericcaiwx-star, @treez-admin, and @obviyus.

name: openclaw 2026.9.35
body:
This is a gateway-only `extended-stable` release, which is our current equivalent to LTS. This release is OpenClaw from the end of September 2026, plus critical security updates, reliability and performance fixes, and features like new model support. The latest version of OpenClaw at the time of this release is [2026.10.7](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/releases#release-v2026.10.7)

## 2026.9.35

### Highlights

- **Steadier memory under service managers:** worker heap caps now apply even when the Gateway service passes a process-wide `--max-old-space-size`, idle Codex app-server clients retire after 30 seconds, and archive workers are reused between session deletes, so long-running Gateways stop accumulating memory. Fixes #179515, #169797, #165663. (#166581, #171490, #168387, #171156, #175091) Thanks @valkyriweb and @RomneyDa.
- **Updates finish more often:** update-time Doctor now removes leftover unknown config keys after migrations, accepts a missing legacy OAuth directory, keeps a valid config that lacks `meta`, settles a completed package publication that already serves the candidate, and no longer overflows on very large session histories. Fixes #174618, #183479. (#175404, #180174, #183703, #180414)
- **Gateway stays responsive:** crafted Microsoft Teams HTML, replies shaped like tool calls, and long streamed HTML or JSX answers no longer stall the Gateway event loop for seconds at a time. (#183438, #183252, #174833, #175472, #180765) Thanks @LeizhenZhang and @JasonBuildAI.
- **Replies reach the user:** the message tool stays directly visible under Tool Search, model fallback works after an unexecuted tool call and for compaction, timed-out MCP sessions no longer break the next turn, and Claude CLI turns that hit the output limit fail fast instead of stalling for 15 minutes. Fixes #176045. (#179450, #183282, #182189, #159931) Thanks @hehuang139, @pstarkgit, @aniketkrs, and @Terwox.
- **Codex native subagents settle correctly:** parents are no longer blocked after native children finish, are interrupted, or complete a follow-up; undeliverable completions are not resurrected; and completed grandchildren no longer replay after a Gateway restart. (#173018, #175246, #179050, #179099, #177577, #181839) Thanks @quqi1599, @wtfichigo, @linancn, and @sunlit-deng.
- **Safer by default:** `test -v` exec operands now require approval in allowlist mode, browser proxy commands are refused through generic node invoke, generated-video downloads use the SSRF guard, and `openclaw mcp list`/`show` plus logs redact credentials. (#180880, #179880, #182425, #180321, #183193) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @brandon-julio-t, and @LeizhenZhang.
- **SQLite 3.54 data safety:** Doctor and update snapshots now repair stale full-text indexes left by the SQLite tokenizer change instead of quarantining agent databases. Fixes #176220. (#176234, #181206)

### Changes

- **Kimi K3.1 Pro:** `moonshot/kimi-k3.1-pro`, `kimi/k3.1-pro`, and their Highspeed variants get the K3 thinking, effort, and video controls; K3.1 rejects `off` locally instead of returning a provider 400. (#181923) Thanks @obviyus.
- **Known-issue documentation:** documented the `--preserve-symlinks` plugin capture workaround, the 2026.8.35 updater's schema warning, and recovery after a publication-journal device-number change. Related #175591, #170031. (#184143) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- **Credential and content boundaries:** require approval for `test`/`[` `-v` operands, refuse browser proxy commands on generic node invoke, guard generated-video downloads, redact MCP inspection output and Google OAuth client secrets, keep commentary out of turns whose replies are disabled, and keep private media out of silent turns. (#180880, #179880, #182425, #180321, #183193, #178518, #129244) Thanks @eleqtrizit, @brandon-julio-t, @LeizhenZhang, and @obviyus.
- **Reply delivery and fallback:** keep the message tool visible under Tool Search, allow model fallback after unexecuted tool calls and for compaction, fall back immediately on exhausted Anthropic usage caps, recover unfinished tool work after empty `length` stops, and keep rejected Claude CLI drafts out of final replies. Fixes #176045, #176179. (#169091, #179450, #183282, #176186, #153728, #168764) Thanks @hehuang139, @pstarkgit, @sunlit-deng, @zhangguiping-xydt, and @ruel225.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** bound regex and tag scans for Microsoft Teams HTML, tool-call-shaped replies, and long streamed markup. (#183438, #183252, #174833, #175472, #180765) Thanks @LeizhenZhang and @JasonBuildAI.
- **Claude CLI sessions:** ignore request echoes when checking for orphaned tool calls, classify rejected resume checkpoints as an expired session, end output-limit stalls promptly, and stop announce wakes from resetting CLI chats. (#172026, #159931, #181308, #176218) Thanks @Terwox, @mushuiyu886, and @eliavb43.
- **Agent runtime:** release completed attempt callbacks, finish parent handoff after cancelling child tasks, cap large subagent completion batches, preserve memory captures during concurrent session resets, load skills when macOS workspace casing differs, and stop thinking-only replies from utility models, including custom GLM title models. (#183884, #178893, #172068, #181081, #181236, #169920, #172580) Thanks @brianmcguire and @jason-allen-oneal.
- **Codex:** retire idle unowned app-server clients, keep native tool declarations stable on completion turns, keep native liveness during host work, and settle native subagent completions, interruptions, follow-ups, and restart replay. Fixes #165663. (#168387, #183286, #181839, #173018, #175246, #179050, #179099, #177577) Thanks @sunlit-deng, @quqi1599, @wtfichigo, and @linancn.
- **Channels:** recover Slack socket mode from an isolated `invalid_auth` and Slack relay connections from silent network drops, tag only Matrix control commands with a command source, keep Telegram offset checkpoints working on Bun, keep the realtime voice transport runtime for callbacks, and keep channel accounts restarting after an exited run is cancelled. Fixes #179398. (#181056, #182368, #179506, #178909, #179462, #182433) Thanks @mushuiyu886, @xiaopan-xydt, @brianmcguire, and @shoaibulhaque.
- **MCP and GitHub tools:** let concurrent agents read a fresh shared MCP OAuth credential without the exclusive lease, and accept GitHub PR publishing from operators whose profile attaches after connect. (#179997, #169400) Thanks @maliv2 and @Gigaxel.
- **Gateway, state, and readiness:** answer trusted-proxy readiness probes without forwarded headers, bound channel-identity admission waits so stalled admission cannot pin WAL checkpoints, keep queued startup work off temporary SQLite reader scopes, avoid writer stalls during initial host admission, preserve live state-lock owners while recovering stale Linux locks, and finish worker shutdown after inventory retirement. Related #143524. (#182823, #172244, #182615, #171549, #175118, #168862) Thanks @ericcaiwx-star, @xialonglee, and @xiaopan-xydt.
- **Update, install, and Doctor:** remove unowned config keys during updates, accept a missing legacy OAuth directory, keep a valid config that lacks `meta`, route debug logs off JSON stdout during admission, bound the post-activation Doctor step and update baseline checks, recover the Node runtime when started from `/`, accept unchanged dist files with extra execute bits, tolerate absent optional packages in Windows swaps, launch SQLite helpers hidden on Windows, create the state directory `0700` regardless of umask, admit group-writable plugin secret resolvers, allow SQLite readers during stopped backups, import transcripts whose filename differs from the header, read cron history identities before payloads, avoid stack overflow on very large session histories, settle a completed package publication that already serves the candidate, and refuse a registry update before staging when the Gateway's Node does not satisfy the target's `engines.node` instead of crash-looping after the switch. Fixes #174618, #183479, #183149. (#180769, #175404, #180174, #183703, #182850, #173862, #181906, #178112, #181141, #181596, #174969, #179538, #181127, #180827, #178146, #174530, #180414) Thanks @jalehman and @wangmiao0668000666.
- **Plugins:** replace dangling dependency junctions instead of refusing plugin migration, copy native captures across filesystems, and tolerate ctime-only stat drift in native companion admission. (#179549, #179445, #179949) Thanks @coaiMax.
- **SQLite full-text indexes:** repair stale FTS indexes after the SQLite 3.54 tokenizer change in Doctor and update snapshots instead of quarantining agent data. Fixes #176220. (#176234, #181206)
- **Release validation compatibility:** carry the release-retrospective batch 5 tooling (admission pins, compact reuse plans, Plugin SDK revision rendering) needed by current full-release validation. (#181920) Thanks @RomneyDa.
